svg.title: Physical cutout: both layers route around removed PCB material
svg.desc: High-frequency image-current approximation projected onto a conservative copper mesh. Colors show |J| in A/mm². White indicates absent ground copper. Dark lines show top-layer signals. Arrows show computed return direction.

g.text: Physical cutout: both layers route around removed PCB material
Conservative image-current approximation · max conservation error 9.7e-10 A
